Global Estimates of Modern Slavery Forced Labour and Forced Marriage
全球现代奴隶制、强迫劳动和强迫婚姻的估计

Executive summary
执行摘要

September 2022
2022年9月

Executive summary
执行摘要

Modern slavery is the very antithesis of social justice and sustainable development. The 2021 Global Estimates indicate there are 50 million people in situations of modern slavery on any given day, either forced to work against their will or in a marriage that they were forced into. This number translates to nearly one of every 150 people in the world. The estimates also indicate that situations of modern slavery are by no means transient – entrapment in forced labour can last years, while in most cases forced marriage is a life sentence. And sadly, the situation is not improving. The 2021 Global Estimates show that millions more men, women, and children have been forced to work or marry in the period since the previous estimates were released in 2017.
现代奴隶制与社会正义和可持续发展背道而驰。2021年全球估算数据显示，每天有5000万人处于现代奴隶制的境地，他们被迫违背意愿劳动或被迫结婚。这意味着全球每150人中就有近1人遭受现代奴隶制的侵害。估算还表明，现代奴隶制绝非短暂现象——被迫劳动可能持续数年，而强迫婚姻在大多数情况下等同于终身监禁。令人遗憾的是，情况并未好转。2021年全球估算数据显示，自2017年发布上一份估算数据以来，又有数百万男性、女性和儿童被迫劳动或结婚。

Through the adoption of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the global community has committed to ending modern slavery among children by 2025, and universally by 2030 (Target 8.7). This report underscores the scale of the challenge facing the global community in the short period remaining to meet these ambitious targets.
通过采纳可持续发展目标（SDGs），国际社会承诺到 2025 年消除现代儿童奴役现象，到 2030 年实现全球消除（目标 8.7）。本报告强调了在剩余的短时间内，国际社会为实现这些雄心勃勃的目标所面临的挑战之巨大。

Compounding crises – the COVID-19 pandemic, armed conflicts, and climate change – in recent years have led to unprecedented disruption to employment and education, increases in extreme poverty and forced and unsafe migration, and an upsurge in reports of gender-based violence, together serving to heighten the risk of all forms of modern slavery. As is usually the case, it is those who are already in situations of greatest vulnerability – including the poor and socially excluded, workers in the informal economy, irregular or otherwise unprotected migrant workers, and people subject to discrimination – who are most affected.
近年来，新冠疫情、武装冲突和气候变化等多重危机叠加，导致就业和教育遭受前所未有的冲击，极端贫困和被迫及不安全移民现象加剧，基于性别的暴力事件报告激增，所有这些因素共同加剧了各种形式的现代奴役风险。通常情况下，受影响最大的往往是那些原本就处境最为脆弱的人群，包括贫困人口和社会边缘群体、非正规经济从业者、非法或缺乏保障的移民工人以及遭受歧视的人群。

It is urgent that the global community gathers the will and resources to overcome these obstacles and get progress towards ending modern slavery back on track. Promises and statements of good intent are not enough. While the principal responsibility for change lies with national governments, a whole of society approach is needed – the social partners, participants in the social and solidarity economy, businesses, investors, survivor groups, civil society, and an array of other actors have critical roles to play. Technical cooperation and assistance from UN agencies, other multilateral and bilateral organizations, international non-governmental organizations, and other groups will also be important to progress. Social dialogue provides an essential framework for building lasting, consensus-based solutions to the challenge of modern slavery.
国际社会亟需凝聚决心和资源，克服这些障碍，使消除现代奴隶制的进程重回正轨。仅仅做出承诺和发表善意声明是不够的。虽然变革的主要责任在于各国政府，但需要采取全社会参与的方式——社会伙伴、社会和团结经济的参与者、企业、投资者、幸存者团体、民间社会以及其他各方都发挥着至关重要的作用。联合国机构、其他多边和双边组织、国际非政府组织和其他团体的技术合作和援助对于取得进展也至关重要。社会对话为构建持久的、基于共识的现代奴隶制解决方案提供了必要的框架。

The global and regional estimates presented in this report were developed by the International Labour Organization (ILO), Walk Free, and the International Organization for Migration (IOM). The estimates are based on a jointly developed methodology summarised in the Annex and described in detail in the methodology report produced along with this 2021 Global Estimates report. As was the case for the 2016 global estimates, the 2021 calculations are derived from multiple data sources, as no single source was sufficiently reliable. The principal sources are data from nationally representative household surveys – 68 forced labour surveys and 75 forced marriage surveys – jointly conducted by ILO and Walk Free, as well as the Counter Trafficking Data Collaborative (CTDC) anonymised case dataset on victims of trafficking collected by IOM and its partners in the process of providing protection and assistance services to trafficked persons.
本报告中呈现的全球和区域估算数据由国际劳工组织（劳工组织）、“自由行走”（Walk Free）组织和国际移民组织（移民组织）共同编制。这些估算数据基于附件中概述的联合开发方法，该方法在与本《2021 年全球估算报告》一同发布的详细方法论报告中进行了描述。与 2016 年全球估算数据一样，2021 年的计算也采用了多种数据来源，因为没有单一数据源足够可靠。主要数据来源包括劳工组织和“自由行走”组织联合开展的具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据——68 项强迫劳动调查和 75 项强迫婚姻调查；以及由国际移民组织及其合作伙伴在向被贩运者提供保护和援助服务过程中收集的关于人口贩运受害者的匿名案例数据集，该数据集来自打击人口贩运数据合作组织（CTDC）。

Overview of key findings
主要发现概述

Modern slavery, as defined for the purpose of the global estimates, is comprised of two principal components – forced labour and forced marriage. Both refer to situations of exploitation that a person cannot refuse or cannot leave because of threats, violence, deception, abuse of power or other forms of coercion.
根据全球估算标准，现代奴隶制主要由两部分组成——强迫劳动和强迫婚姻。两者都指因受到威胁、暴力、欺骗、滥用权力或其他形式的胁迫而无法拒绝或摆脱的剥削境地。

The scourge of modern slavery has by no means been relegated to history. The 2021 Global Estimates indicate that 49.6 million people are in modern slavery on any given day, either forced to work against their will or in a marriage that they were forced into. Forced labour accounts for 27.6 million of those in modern slavery and forced marriage for 22 million.
现代奴隶制的祸害远未成为历史。2021年全球估计数据显示，每天有4960万人处于现代奴隶制之下，他们被迫违背意愿劳动或被迫结婚。其中，2760万人遭受强迫劳动，2200万人被迫结婚。

Forced labour
强迫劳动

Forced labour, as set out in the ILO Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No.29), 1^{1} refers to “all work or service which is exacted from any person under the menace of any penalty and for which the said person has not offered himself voluntarily.”
根据1930年国际劳工组织《强迫劳动公约》的规定，强迫劳动属于违法行为。 （第29号） 1^{1} 指“根据……向任何人索取的所有工作或服务”。 任何处罚的威胁，而该人并未对此表示同意 他本人是自愿的。

There are 27.6 million people in situations of forced labour on any given day. This absolute number translates to 3.5 people in forced labour for every thousand people in the world. Women and girls make up 11.8 million of the total in forced labour. More than 3.3 million of all those in forced labour are children.
每天，全球约有2760万人处于强迫劳动状态。这意味着，全球每千人中就有3.5人遭受强迫劳动。其中，妇女和女童占1180万人，儿童超过330万人。

Forced labour has grown in recent years. A simple comparison with the 2016 global estimates indicates an increase of 2.7 million in the number people in forced labour between 2016 and 2021, which translates to a rise in the prevalence of forced labour from 3.4 to 3.5 per thousand people in the world. The increase in the number of people in forced labour was driven entirely by forced labour in the private economy, both in forced commercial sexual exploitation and in forced labour in other sectors.
近年来，强迫劳动现象日益严重。与2016年全球估计数据相比，2016年至2021年间，强迫劳动人数增加了270万，这意味着全球强迫劳动发生率从每千人3.4人上升至3.5人。强迫劳动人数的增加完全是由私营经济领域的强迫劳动造成的，包括强迫性商业性剥削和其他行业的强迫劳动。

The initial months of the COVID-19 pandemic were accompanied by widespread reports of forced labour linked to the crisis. Disruptions to income because of the pandemic led to greater indebtedness among workers and with it reports of a rise in debt bondage among some workers lacking access to formal credit channels. The crisis also resulted in a deterioration of working conditions for many workers, in some cases leading to forced labour. Yet little is known about how forced labour risks have evolved since the initial months of the crisis, as strict economy-wide workplace shutdowns were phased out in most countries and the world economy began its fragile recovery. There are many reasons for concern in this regard. The World Bank indicates that extreme poverty – one important metric of forced labour risk – remains far higher than the pre-pandemic trajectory 2^{2} and the ILO reports that the jobs recovery has stalled in much of the world. 3^{3}
新冠疫情爆发的最初几个月伴随着 危机期间，有关强迫劳动的报道层出不穷。 疫情导致的收入减少使得劳动者的债务负担加重。 随之而来的是一些缺乏资源的工人中债务奴役现象日益严重的报道。 获得正规信贷渠道的渠道受限。这场危机还导致了…… 在某些情况下，许多工人的工作条件恶化 导致强迫劳动。然而，人们对强迫劳动的成因知之甚少。 自危机爆发初期以来，风险已经发生了变化，因为严格的…… 大多数国家逐步取消了全经济范围的工作场所停工措施， 世界经济开始脆弱复苏。原因有很多。 对此表示担忧。世界银行指出，极端贫困—— 衡量强迫劳动风险的一项重要指标——仍然远高于…… 疫情前轨迹 2^{2} 国际劳工组织报告称，大部分地区的就业复苏已经停滞。 世界。 3^{3}

No region of the world is spared from forced labour. Asia and the Pacific is host to more than half of the global total (15.1 million), followed by Europe and Central Asia (4.1 million), Africa (3.8 million), the Americas (3.6 million), and the Arab States (0.9 million). But this regional ranking changes considerably when forced labour is expressed as a proportion of the population. By this measure, forced labour is highest in the Arab States (5.3 per thousand people), followed by Europe and Central Asia (4.4 per thousand), the Americas and Asia and the Pacific (both at 3.5 per thousand), and Africa (2.9 per thousand).
世界上没有哪个地区能够幸免于强迫劳动。亚太地区占全球总数的一半以上（1510万），其次是欧洲和中亚（410万）、非洲（380万）、美洲（360万）和阿拉伯国家（90万）。但如果以强迫劳动人口比例来衡量，这一区域排名就会发生显著变化。按此标准衡量，阿拉伯国家的强迫劳动人口比例最高（每千人5.3人），其次是欧洲和中亚（每千人4.4人），美洲和亚太地区（均为每千人3.5人），非洲（每千人2.9人）。

Forced labour is a concern regardless of a country’s wealth. More than half of all forced labour occurs in either upper-middle income or high-income countries. When population is taken into account, forced labour is highest in low income countries (6.3 per thousand people) followed by high income countries (4.4 per thousand).
无论一个国家经济状况如何，强迫劳动都是一个值得关注的问题。超过一半的强迫劳动发生在中等偏上收入或高收入国家。如果将人口因素考虑在内，强迫劳动发生率最高的是低收入国家（每千人6.3人），其次是高收入国家（每千人4.4人）。

Most forced labour occurs in the private economy. Eighty-six per cent of forced labour cases are imposed by private actors – 63 per cent in the private economy in sectors other than commercial sexual exploitation and 23 per cent in forced commercial sexual exploitation. State-imposed forced labour accounts for the remaining 14 per cent of people in forced labour.
大多数强迫劳动发生在私营经济领域。86%的强迫劳动案例是由私人行为者实施的——其中63%发生在私营经济领域中非商业性剥削的行业，23%发生在商业性剥削领域。国家强制实施的强迫劳动占剩余的14%。

Forced labour touches virtually all parts of the private economy. The five sectors accounting for the majority of total adult forced labour (87 per cent) are services (excluding domestic work), manufacturing, construction, agriculture (excluding fishing), and domestic work. Other sectors form smaller shares but nonetheless still account for hundreds of thousands of people. These include adult workers who are forced to dig for minerals or perform other mining and quarrying work, fishers who are trapped in forced labour aboard fishing vessels, people forced to beg on the street, and people forced into illicit activities.
强迫劳动几乎渗透到私营经济​​的各个领域。占成年人强迫劳动总量绝大部分（87%）的五个行业分别是服务业（不包括家政服务）、制造业、建筑业、农业（不包括渔业）和家政服务。其他行业占比虽小，但仍涉及数十万人。这些人包括被迫挖掘矿产或从事其他采矿和采石工作的成年工人、被迫在渔船上从事强迫劳动的渔民、被迫在街头乞讨的人以及被迫从事非法活动的人。

The composition of forced labour differs from that of the broader labour force in a number of ways. The share of migrants in the group of people in forced labour is much higher than the share of migrants in the overall labour force. There are also relatively more men among workers in forced labour compared to the labour force generally. People in forced labour are more likely to be in manufacturing, and much more likely to be in construction, than workers in the overall labour force. They are less likely to be in the services and agriculture sectors than workers in the overall labour force.
强迫劳动者的构成与整体劳动力构成在许多方面存在差异。强迫劳动者群体中移民的比例远高于移民在整体劳动力中的比例。此外，与整体劳动力相比，强迫劳动者中男性比例也相对较高。强迫劳动者更有可能从事制造业，尤其更有可能从事建筑业，而从事服务业和农业的可能性则低于整体劳动力。

People in forced labour exploitation are subjected to multiple forms of coercion to compel them to work against their will. The systematic and deliberate withholding of wages, used by abusive employers to compel workers to stay in a job out of fear of losing accrued earnings, is the most common form of coercion, experienced by 36 per cent of those in forced labour. This is followed by abuse of vulnerability through threat of dismissal, which was experienced by one in five of those in forced labour. More severe forms of coercion, including forced confinement, physical and sexual violence, and the deprivation of basic needs, are less common but by no means negligible.
遭受强迫劳动剥削的人们会受到多种形式的胁迫，被迫违背意愿工作。其中最常见的胁迫形式是系统性、蓄意地克扣工资，施虐的雇主以此迫使工人因害怕失去已积累的收入而继续工作，36%的强迫劳动者都经历过这种胁迫。其次是利用弱势群体，以解雇相威胁，五分之一的强迫劳动者都曾遭受过这种胁迫。更严重的胁迫形式，包括强制监禁、身体和性暴力以及剥夺基本生活必需品，虽然较少见，但也绝非微不足道。

Forced labour in the private economy has an important gender dimension. Women in forced labour are much more likely than their male counterparts to be in domestic work, while men in forced labour are much more likely to be in the construction sector. Women are more likely to be coerced through wage non-payment and abuse of vulnerability, and men through threats of violence and financial penalties. Women are also more likely than men to be subjected to physical and sexual violence and threats against family members.
私营经济中的强迫劳动具有显著的性别差异。与男性相比，女性强迫劳动者更有可能从事家政工作，而男性强迫劳动者更有可能从事建筑行业。女性更容易因拖欠工资和利用弱势地位而受到胁迫，男性则更容易因暴力威胁和经济处罚而受到胁迫。此外，女性比男性更容易遭受身体和性暴力以及对家庭成员的威胁。

Migrant workers face a higher risk of forced labour than other workers. The forced labour prevalence of adult migrant workers is more than three times higher than that of adult non-migrant workers. This figure makes clear that when migrant workers are not protected by law or are unable to exercise their rights, migration is irregular or poorly governed, or where recruitment practices are unfair or unethical, migration can lead to situations of vulnerability to forced labour.
与其他劳动者相比，移徙工人面临更高的强迫劳动风险。成年移徙工人的强迫劳动发生率是成年非移徙工人的三倍多。这一数据清楚地表明，当移徙工人得不到法律保护或无法行使自身权利，当移徙活动不规范或管理不善，或者当招聘行为不公平或不道德时，移徙就可能导致他们更容易遭受强迫劳动。

An estimated 6.3 million people are in situations of forced commercial sexual exploitation at any point in time. Gender is a key determining factor: nearly four out of every five people trapped in these situations are girls or women.
据估计，任何时候都有630万人处于被迫从事商业性剥削的境地。性别是关键的决定因素：在这些困境中，近五分之四的人是女孩或妇女。

The tragedy of children subjected to forced labour demands special urgency. A total of 3.3 million children are in situations of forced labour, accounting for about 12 per cent of all those in forced labour. And because of data constraints, these numbers, already alarming, may well be just the tip of the iceberg. The forced labour of children constitutes one component of child labour, 4^{4} which the international community – through Target 8.7 of the Sustainable Development Goals – has committed to ending by 2025.
儿童被迫劳动的悲剧需要特别关注。 情况紧急。共有330万儿童处于被迫境地。 劳工约占所有强迫劳动者的 12%。 由于数据限制，这些已经令人担忧的数字可能还会进一步减少。 这只是冰山一角。童工问题依然存在。 这是童工现象的一个组成部分。 4^{4} 国际社会通过目标8.7来实现这一目标 可持续发展目标——承诺在 2025 年前结束。

The forced labour of children occurs across wide array of economic sectors and industries. Over half of all children in forced labour are in commercial sexual exploitation. 5^{5} Domestic work, agriculture, and manufacturing are among the many other sectors where children in forced labour are found. Qualitative reports indicate that children can be subjected to severe forms of coercion and abuse, including abduction, drugging, being held in captivity, deception, and manipulation of debt. Some of the worst abuses occur in situations of armed conflict.
强迫童工现象存在于各种经济领域。 各个部门和行业。超过一半的被迫劳动儿童来自各个领域。 在商业性剥削中。 5^{5} 家务劳动、农业和制造业是众多其他行业中的一部分。 存在童工现象的行业。定性报告 这表明儿童可能遭受严重的胁迫形式， 虐待，包括绑架、下药、囚禁等。 欺骗和操纵债务。一些最严重的滥用行为发生在…… 武装冲突局势。

The 2021 Global Estimates indicate that 3.9 million people are in state-imposed forced labour at any point in time. Males make up more than three of every four of those in forced labour imposed by state authorities, while 8 per cent of those in state-imposed forced labour are children. Over half (55 per cent) of all cases involve some form of abuse of compulsory prison labour, 27 per cent involve the abuse of conscription and 17 per cent involve forced labour for economic development or for work beyond normal civic obligations.
2021年全球估计数据显示，任何时候都有390万人处于国家强制劳动状态。在这些被国家强制劳动的人群中，男性占四分之三以上，儿童占8%。超过半数（55%）的案例涉及某种形式的强制监狱劳动，27%涉及滥用征兵制度，17%涉及为促进经济发展或从事超出正常公民义务的工作而进行的强制劳动。

Forced marriage
强迫婚姻

Forced marriage is a complex and highly gendered practice. Although men and boys are also forced to marry, it predominantly affects women and girls. Forced marriages occur in every region of the world and cut across ethnic, cultural, and religious lines. The many drivers of forced marriage are closely linked to longstanding patriarchal attitudes and practices and are highly context specific.
强迫婚姻是一种复杂且性别色彩浓厚的现象。虽然男性和男孩也会被迫结婚，但它主要影响的是女性和女孩。强迫婚姻遍布世界各地，超越了种族、文化和宗教的界限。导致强迫婚姻的诸多因素与根深蒂固的父权制态度和习俗密切相关，并且具有很强的地域性。

The number of men, women, and children living in forced marriages has risen globally. An estimated 22 million people were living in situations of forced marriage on any given day in 2021. This is a 6.6 million increase in the number of people living in a forced marriage between 2016 and 2021, which translates to a rise in prevalence from 2.1 to 2.8 per thousand people.
全球范围内，被迫结婚的男性、女性和儿童人数有所增加。据估计，2021年每天约有2200万人生活在被迫婚姻的境况中。与2016年至2021年相比，被迫结婚的人数增加了660万，相当于每千人中有2.1人被迫结婚，上升至2.8人。

Forced marriages take place in every region in the world. Nearly two-thirds of all forced marriages, an estimated 14.2 million people, are in Asia and the Pacific. This is followed by 14.5 per cent in Africa (3.2 million) and 10.4 per cent in Europe and Central Asia (2.3 million). When we account for the population in each region, prevalence of forced marriage is highest in the Arab States (4.8 per thousand population), followed by Asia and the Pacific (3.3 per thousand population).
强迫婚姻在世界各地均有发生。全球近三分之二的强迫婚姻案例（估计达1420万人）发生在亚太地区。其次是非洲（14.5%，约320万人）和欧洲及中亚（10.4%，约230万人）。若按各地区的人口比例计算，阿拉伯国家的强迫婚姻发生率最高（每千人4.8例），其次是亚太地区（每千人3.3例）。

Over two-thirds of those forced to marry are female. This equates to an estimated 14.9 million women and girls. While women and girls account for the majority of people living in a forced marriage, men and boys are also subjected to forced marriage.
被迫结婚的人中，超过三分之二是女性，估计约有1490万妇女和女孩。虽然妇女和女孩占被迫婚姻人群的大多数，但男性和男孩也同样遭受强迫婚姻的侵害。

Three in every five people in a forced marriage are in lower-middle income countries; however, wealthier nations are not immune, with 26 per cent of forced marriages in high or upper-middle income countries.
五分之三的强迫婚姻发生在低收入和中等收入国家；然而，较富裕的国家也未能幸免，26%的强迫婚姻发生在高收入或中高收入国家。

Family members were responsible for the vast majority of forced marriages. Most persons who reported on the circumstances of forced marriage were forced to marry by their parents (73 per cent) or other relatives (16 per cent).
绝大多数强迫婚姻是由家庭成员造成的。在报告强迫婚姻情况的人中，大多数人是被父母（73%）或其他亲属（16%）强迫结婚的。

Half of those living in forced marriages were coerced using emotional threats or verbal abuse. This includes the use of emotional blackmail – for example, parents threatening self-harm or asserting that the family’s reputation will be ruined – and threats of estrangement from family members, among other things. Physical or sexual violence and threats of violence were the next most used form of coercion to force a marriage (19 per cent).
在被迫结婚的人中，有一半是遭受情感威胁或言语虐待而被迫结婚的。这包括情感勒索——例如，父母威胁自残或声称家族名誉将毁于一旦——以及威胁与家人断绝关系等等。身体或性暴力以及暴力威胁是第二大常用的强迫婚姻胁迫手段（19%）。

Once forced to marry, there is greater risk of sexual exploitation, violence, and domestic servitude and other forms of forced labour both inside and outside the home. Females are more likely than males to report being forced to perform work by their spouse or the spouse’s family.
一旦被迫结婚，遭受性剥削、暴力、家庭奴役以及其他形式的强迫劳动（无论是在家庭内部还是外部）的风险都会大大增加。女性比男性更有可能报告被配偶或配偶的家人强迫劳动。

COVID-19 has exacerbated the underlying drivers of all forms of modern slavery, including forced marriage, which often is linked to economic hardship. Widespread socio-economic instability due to the pandemic led to increased global unemployment, increased indebtedness, and an increase in extreme global poverty for the first time in two decades. As the data only partially reflect the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic, the estimates presented in this report are likely to understate the full magnitude of the pandemic’s impact.
新冠疫情加剧了包括强迫婚姻在内的各种现代奴隶制形式的根本驱动因素，而强迫婚姻往往与经济困境密切相关。疫情造成的广泛社会经济不稳定导致全球失业率上升、债务增加，以及近二十年来全球极端贫困人口首次增多。由于现有数据仅部分反映了新冠疫情的影响，本报告中的估算可能低估了疫情影响的全部程度。

Ending modern slavery: the path to 2030
终结现代奴隶制：通往2030年的道路

Nothing can justify the persistence of modern slavery in today’s world. We can and must do better. It is not a question of not knowing what to do. There is a substantial and growing body of policy and programming experience in addressing modern slavery, offering critical guidance for the future. The overall rise in modern slavery also masks numerous contexts that have registered significant reductions, offering additional key insights into the policy choices needed for progress. International legal instruments provide the normative framework for efforts against modern slavery. 6^{6}
没有任何理由可以为当今社会现代奴隶制的持续存在辩护。 世界。我们能够也必须做得更好。这不是我们不懂的问题。 该怎么办？目前已有大量且不断增长的政策和措施， 在解决现代奴隶制问题方面拥有丰富的编程经验，并提供关键信息 对未来的指导。现代奴隶制的总体上升也掩盖了…… 许多领域都出现了显著下降，并提供 为推进政策选择提供更多关键见解。 国际法律文书为以下方面提供了规范框架： 打击现代奴隶制的努力。 6^{6}

Some of the key policy priorities for addressing forced labour and forced marriage in the lead up to the 2030 target date for ending modern slavery are discussed below.
下面讨论的是为实现 2030 年消除现代奴隶制的目标日期而需要重点关注的一些政策优先事项，以解决强迫劳动和强迫婚姻问题。

Forced labour
强迫劳动

  • Respect for the freedoms of workers to associate and to bargain collectively is indispensable to a world free from forced labour. These fundamental labour rights enable workers to exert a collective voice to defend their shared interests and to bargain collectively for secure and decent work, thus creating workplaces that are inimical to forced labour and workers who are resilient to its risks. These rights are essential prerequisites for social dialogue, which in turn is critical to building lasting, consensus-based solutions to the challenge of forced labour. Currently, workers in much of the world, and the vast majority of workers in the informal economy – migrants as well as nationals – lack a representative and collective voice.
    尊重工人结社和集体谈判的自由，对于一个没有强迫劳动的世界至关重要。这些基本劳动权利使工人能够发出集体声音，捍卫共同利益，并集体谈判争取安全体面的工作，从而创造不利于强迫劳动的工作场所，并增强工人抵御强迫劳动风险的能力。这些权利是社会对话的必要前提，而社会对话对于构建持久的、基于共识的强迫劳动解决方案至关重要。目前，世界许多地区的工人，以及非正规经济中的绝大多数工人——包括移民和本国公民——都缺乏代表性和集体话语权。

  • Extend social protection, including floors, to all workers and their families, to mitigate the socio-economic vulnerability that underpins much of forced labour, and to provide workers with the basic income security to be able to say no to jobs that are abusive and to quit jobs that have become so. Extending social protection coverage in the informal economy is a priority. It is important that social protection also provides inclusive, equitable and non-discriminatory coverage to migrants.
    将包括最低保障在内的社会保障覆盖范围扩大到所有劳动者及其家庭，以减轻导致强迫劳动现象普遍存在的社会经济脆弱性，并为劳动者提供基本收入保障，使他们能够拒绝遭受虐待的工作，并主动辞去已经沦为虐待的工作。扩大非正规经济领域的社会保障覆盖范围是一项优先事项。此外，社会保障还必须为移民提供包容、公平和非歧视性的保障。

  • Promote fair and ethical recruitment, to protect workers from abusive and fraudulent practices during the recruitment and placement process, including the charging of extortionate fees and related costs by unscrupulous recruitment agencies and labour intermediaries. The global estimates indicate that a large share of forced labour cases can be traced to abuses occurring during the recruitment phase of their employment.
    提倡公平合乎道德的招聘方式，保护劳动者免受招聘和安置过程中的虐待和欺诈行为侵害，包括不法招聘机构和劳务中介收取高额费用及相关成本。全球估计数据显示，很大一部分强迫劳动案件都源于招聘阶段的虐待行为。

  • Strengthen the reach and capacity of public labour inspectorates, so they are able to detect and act on labour violations before they deteriorate into forced labour, able to raise awareness of forced labour risks and the compliance obligations of employers, and able to promptly detect and refer actual forced labour cases. Extending the reach of labour inspectorates into the informal economy is a priority.
    加强公共劳动监察机构的覆盖范围和能力，使其能够在劳动违法行为演变为强迫劳动之前发现并采取行动，提高公众对强迫劳动风险和雇主合规义务的认识，并能够及时发现和移交实际发生的强迫劳动案件。将劳动监察机构的覆盖范围扩展到非正规经济领域是当务之急。

  • Ensure protection for people freed from forced labour, through immediate assistance, rehabilitation, and long-term sustainable solutions, so they can successfully recover and avoid re-victimization. Special consideration should be given to children, migrants, and those trafficked for forced labour. Despite progress, still only a small fraction of those subjected to forced labour and trafficking for forced labour are identified and referred to comprehensive protection services.
    应通过提供即时援助、康复和长期可持续的解决方案，确保从强迫劳动中解救出来的人员得到保护，以便他们能够成功康复并避免再次受害。应特别关注儿童、移民和被贩运从事强迫劳动的人员。尽管取得了一些进展，但只有一小部分遭受强迫劳动和被贩运从事强迫劳动的人员被识别出来并转介到全面的保护服务机构。

  • Ensure access to remedy for people freed from forced labour, to help recompense them for the consequences of their subjection to forced labour and to help in their recovery. Remedies include compensation for material damages (e.g., as medical costs, unpaid wages, legal fees, and loss of earnings and earning potential) or for moral damages (e.g., pain and emotional distress). Currently, only a very small share of those subjected to forced labour and human trafficking are provided with compensation or other forms of remedy.
    确保从强迫劳动中解救出来的人员能够获得救济，以帮助他们弥补遭受强迫劳动造成的后果，并帮助他们康复。救济措施包括物质损害赔偿（例如医疗费用、未付工资、法律费用以及收入和潜在收入损失）或精神损害赔偿（例如精神痛苦和情感创伤）。目前，只有极少数遭受强迫劳动和人口贩运的人员能够获得赔偿或其他形式的救济。

  • Ensure adequate enforcement, to bring perpetrators to justice and deter would-be offenders from contemplating the crime of forced labour. Statistics indicate that the number of cases of forced labour and human trafficking reported for legal investigation remains low and, due to limited capacities for adequate investigation and prosecution of these crimes, the rate of conviction is minimal.
    必须确保执法力度足够，将犯罪分子绳之以法，并震慑潜在的犯罪分子，防止他们考虑实施强迫劳动犯罪。统计数据显示，提交法律调查的强迫劳动和人口贩运案件数量仍然偏低，而且由于对这些犯罪进行充分调查和起诉的能力有限，定罪率也极低。

  • Address migrants’ vulnerability to forced labour and trafficking for forced labour. Although most migration is voluntary and has a largely positive impact on individuals and societies, the global estimates indicate that when migrants are not protected by law or are unable to exercise their rights they can be at increased risk of forced labour and human trafficking. National policy and legal frameworks that promote respect for the rights of all migrants at all stages of the migration process, regardless of their migration status, are urgently needed.
    必须解决移民易受强迫劳动和人口贩运侵害的问题。尽管大多数移民是自愿的，并且对个人和社会产生了普遍的积极影响，但全球估计表明，当移民得不到法律保护或无法行使其权利时，他们遭受强迫劳动和人口贩运的风险就会增加。因此，迫切需要制定国家政策和法律框架，以促进在移民过程的各个阶段尊重所有移民的权利，无论其移民身份如何。

  • Address children trapped in forced labour. Far more investment is needed in identification and protection measures for children in forced labour, including, but not limited to, those in commercial sexual exploitation and those in forced labour linked to armed conflict. Better information on the numbers of children involved, and on the nature and drivers of the forced labour they are trapped in, is urgently needed to inform responses.
    必须关注被困于强迫劳动中的儿童。亟需加大对被困于强迫劳动中的儿童的识别和保护力度，包括但不限于遭受商业性剥削的儿童以及与武装冲突相关的强迫劳动儿童。迫切需要掌握更多关于受害儿童人数、强迫劳动的性质和驱动因素的信息，以便制定应对措施。

  • Mitigate the heightened risk of forced labour and trafficking for forced labour in situations of crisis. Much of forced labour and human trafficking occurs in situations of crisis linked to armed conflicts, disasters, and disease. There is a need to mainstream prevention and protection measures across all phases of crisis responses, from pre-crisis preparedness to humanitarian action following crisis outbreak and on to post-crisis reconstruction and recovery. Measures to sustain livelihoods during crises are especially important in preventing workers from falling into forced labour and trafficking as they struggle to support themselves and their families.
    降低危机局势下强迫劳动和人口贩运风险。许多强迫劳动和人口贩运事件发生在与武装冲突、灾害和疾病相关的危机局势中。有必要将预防和保护措施纳入危机应对的各个阶段，从危机前的准备工作到危机爆发后的人道主义行动，再到危机后的重建和恢复。在危机期间，维持生计的措施尤为重要，可以防止劳动者在努力养活自己和家人时沦为强迫劳动和人口贩运的受害者。

  • Combat forced labour and trafficking for forced labour in business operations and supply chains. Attention should focus on identifying, prioritizing, and acting on “hotspots” where the risk of forced labour and other human rights abuses is highest in terms of both severity and scale. Particularly important in this context are the informal micro- and small enterprises operating at the lower links of supply chains in high-risk sectors and locations.
    打击商业运营和供应链中的强迫劳动和人口贩运。应重点关注并优先处理强迫劳动和其他侵犯人权行为风险最高的“热点地区”，无论从严重程度还是规模来看都是如此。尤其重要的是，在供应链下游、高风险行业和地区运营的非正规微型和小型企业。

  • End state-imposed forced labour, which accounts for one in seven of all forced labour cases. The fact that state-imposed forced labour is the direct product of deliberate laws and practices on the part of states makes abundantly clear what is needed for change – namely, the political commitment and follow-up to reform these same laws and practices.
    终止国家强制劳动，这种劳动占所有强制劳动案件的七分之一。国家强制劳动是国家蓄意制定的法律和实践的直接产物，这一事实清楚地表明了变革的必要条件——即，必须有政治承诺并采取后续行动来改革这些法律和实践。

  • Partnership and international cooperation. The challenge of forced labour is too big, and its myriad root causes too complex, for national governments or other stakeholders to address on their own. Alliance 8.7 plays an important role in facilitating cooperation and experience exchange on forced labour and human trafficking across the array of governmental and non-governmental organizations that make up its wide membership. International support to financing and resource mobilization is one of the key ingredients of broader cooperation and partnership against forced labour.
    伙伴关系与国际合作。强迫劳动的挑战过于艰巨，其根源错综复杂，各国政府或其他利益攸关方仅靠自身之力难以应对。联盟8.7在其广泛的成员组织（包括众多政府和非政府组织）中发挥着重要作用，促进各方在打击强迫劳动和人口贩运方面的合作与经验交流。国际社会对资金筹措和资源调动的支持是开展更广泛的合作与伙伴关系、打击强迫劳动的关键要素之一。

Forced marriage
强迫婚姻

  • As women and girls are disproportionately affected, legislative and policy responses should have a gendered lens, including gender-sensitive laws, policies, programmes, and budgets, including gender-responsive social protection mechanisms. It is important that these initiatives are inclusive, equitable, and provide non-discriminatory access to migrants.
    由于妇女和女童受到的影响尤为严重，立法和政策应对措施应体现性别平等视角，包括制定兼顾性别平等的法律、政策、方案和预算，以及建立性别敏感的社会保障机制。这些举措必须具有包容性和公平性，并确保移民享有非歧视性待遇。

  • Ensure adequate civil and criminal protections in national legislation. This should include raising the legal age of marriage to 18 without exceptions in order to protect children, criminalizing the act of marrying someone who does not consent, regardless of age, and civil protections that protect the individual from marriage without having to penalise the perpetrators, who are often family members. Legislative action should be part of a broader holistic response that tackles underlying drivers of forced marriage, and includes prevention and support measures such as safe accommodation, emergency funds, and psychosocial support.
    确保国家立法中提供充分的民事和刑事保护。这应包括将法定结婚年龄提高到18岁，且不得有任何例外，以保护儿童；将强迫婚姻定为犯罪行为，无论对方年龄多大；以及提供民事保护，使个人免于被迫结婚，而无需惩罚施暴者（通常是家庭成员）。立法行动应是更广泛的整体应对措施的一部分，该措施旨在解决强迫婚姻的根本原因，并包括预防和支持措施，例如提供安全住所、紧急援助资金和心理社会支持。

  • Address underlying socio-cultural norms and structures that contribute to forced marriage. Legislation is not in itself sufficient to end forced marriage and needs to be combined with wider preventative approaches addressing underlying discrimination and gender inequality, as well as related socio-cultural norms. Central to changing these attitudes is context-specific research on vulnerabilities and community-based education, training, and empowerment activities.
    要解决导致强迫婚姻的深层社会文化规范和结构。仅靠立法不足以终结强迫婚姻，还需要结合更广泛的预防措施，以消除潜在的歧视和性别不平等，以及相关的社会文化规范。改变这些态度的关键在于针对具体情境开展脆弱性研究，并开展以社区为基础的教育、培训和赋权活动。

  • Invest in building the agency of women and girls. Ensuring that women and girls have the opportunity and ability to complete school, earn a livelihood, and inherit assets plays a significant role in reducing vulnerability to forced marriage. To support this, institutions and employers should offer employment opportunities for women and girls while providing training for “soft-skills” beyond formal education, such as pre-employment and on-the-job skills building and training programmes.
    投资于增强妇女和女童的自主权。确保妇女和女童有机会和能力完成学业、谋生并继承财产，对于降低她们遭受强迫婚姻的风险至关重要。为支持这一点，机构和雇主应为妇女和女童提供就业机会，同时提供正规教育以外的“软技能”培训，例如岗前和在职技能培训项目。

  • Protect the rights of those vulnerable to forced marriage and trafficking for forced marriage during times of crisis. This requires coordination among humanitarian agencies to create pathways for people to safely leave conflict areas and to provide livelihood and education opportunities, ensure food security, establish free civil registration services (including births and marriages), and build the capacity of local service providers.
    在危机时期，保护易受强迫婚姻和人口贩运侵害者的权利。这需要人道主义机构之间的协调，为人们安全离开冲突地区创造途径，提供生计和教育机会，确保粮食安全，建立免费的民事登记服务（包括出生和婚姻登记），并加强当地服务提供者的能力建设。

  • Address the vulnerability of migrants, particularly children. This includes improving capacity to identify the most vulnerable, as well as ensuring equal access to safe, dignified return and sustainable reintegration such as social protection and services, justice, psychosocial assistance, education, vocational training, employment opportunities, and decent work, regardless of their migration status. Legal identity is a core enabler of sustainable development and safe and regular migration; access to legal identity registration procedures is particularly important for migrants at risk of forced marriage.
    关注移民，特别是儿童的脆弱性。这包括提高识别最弱势群体的能力，以及确保无论其移民身份如何，都能平等地获得安全、有尊严的返回和可持续的重新融入，例如社会保障和服务、司法救助、心理社会援助、教育、职业培训、就业机会和体面工作。合法身份是可持续发展以及安全、正常移民的核心保障；对于面临强迫婚姻风险的移民而言，获得合法身份登记程序尤为重要。

Reliable information and statistics on forced labour, forced marriage, and human trafficking are critical to promoting awareness and understanding of the problem, and to informing policy responses. It is hoped that the findings presented in the report will encourage further research and data collection efforts focused on the national and local dimensions of all forms of modern slavery.
关于强迫劳动、强迫婚姻和人口贩运的可靠信息和统计数据对于提高公众对该问题的认识和理解，以及为政策应对提供依据至关重要。希望本报告中的研究结果能够鼓励开展更多研究和数据收集工作，重点关注现代奴隶制各种形式的国家和地方层面。

Endnotes
尾注

1 ILO, Forced Labour Convention, 1930 (No. 29).
1 国际劳工组织，《强迫劳动公约》，1930 年（第 29 号）。

2 Daniel Gerszon Mahler, Nishant Yonzan, Ruth Hill, Christoph Lakner, Haoyu Wu and Nobuo Yoshida, “Pandemic, prices, and poverty”, World Bank Blogs (blog), 13 April 2022.
2 Daniel Gerszon Mahler、Nishant Yonzan、Ruth Hill、Christoph Lakner、Haoyu Wu 和 Nobuo Yoshida，“疫情、价格和贫困”，世界银行博客（博客），2022 年 4 月 13 日。

3 ILO, ILO Monitor on the world of work. Ninth edition, 2022.
3 国际劳工组织，《国际劳工组织工作世界监测报告》，第九版，2022年。

4 Forced labour of children is defined, for purposes of measurement, as work performed by a child during a specified reference period falling under one of the following categories: (i) work performed for a third party, under threat or menace of any penalty applied by a third party (other than the child’ own parents) either on the child directly or the child’s parents; or (ii) work performed with or for the child’s parents, under threat or menace of any penalty applied by a third party (other than the child’s parents) either on the child directly or the child’s parents; or (iii) work performed with or for the child’s parents where one or both parents are themselves in a situation of forced labour; or (iv) work performed in anyone of the following worst forms of child labour: (a) all forms of slavery or practices similar to slavery, such as the sale and trafficking of children, debt bondage and serfdom, [as well as forced or compulsory labour, including forced or compulsory recruitment of children for use in armed conflict; (b) the use, procuring or offering of a child for prostitution, for the production of pornography or for pornographic performances; (c) the use, procuring or offering of a child for illicit activities, in particular for the production and trafficking of drugs as defined in relevant international treaties.
4. 为便于衡量，强迫童工的定义是指儿童在特定参考期内从事的属于以下类别之一的工作：(i) 为第三方工作，并受到第三方（儿童的父母除外）直接或间接施加的任何惩罚的威胁或恐吓；或 (ii) 与儿童的父母一起或为儿童的父母工作，并受到第三方（儿童的父母除外）直接或间接施加的任何惩罚的威胁或恐吓；或 (iii) 与儿童的父母一起或为儿童的父母工作，而父母一方或双方本身处于强迫劳动状态；或 (iv) 从事以下最恶劣形式的童工劳动：(a) 所有形式的奴役或类似奴役的做法，例如贩卖儿童、债务奴役和农奴制，以及强迫或强制劳动，包括强迫或强制招募儿童参与武装冲突； （b）利用、招募或提供儿童从事卖淫、制作色情制品或进行色情表演；（c）利用、招募或提供儿童从事非法活动，特别是从事相关国际条约所界定的毒品生产和贩运。

5 In accordance with the ILO Worst Forms of Child Labour Convention, 1999 (No. 182), any type of commercial sexual exploitation is considered forced labour when minors are involved
5. 根据国际劳工组织1999年《最恶劣形式童工劳动公约》（第182号），任何涉及未成年人的商业性剥削均视为强迫劳动。

6 Including the ILO Forced Labour Conventions Nos 29 and 105; the Worst Forms of Child Labour Convention, 1999 (No. 182); the Protocol of 2014 to the Forced Labour Convention, 1930; the Forced Labour (Supplementary Measures) Recommendation, 2014 (No. 203); the United Nations 1956 Convention on slavery and slavery-like practices; the United Nations Protocol to Prevent, Suppress and Punish Trafficking in Persons (2000) supplementing the UN Convention against Transnational Crime; the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child; and the UN Convention on the Elimination of all Forms of Discrimination Against Women.
6 其中包括国际劳工组织《强迫劳动公约》第29号和第105号；1999年《最恶劣形式的童工劳动公约》（第182号）；1930年《强迫劳动公约》2014年议定书；2014年《强迫劳动（补充措施）建议书》（第203号）；1956年联合国《关于奴隶制和类似奴隶制做法的公约》；2000年联合国《关于防止、制止和惩治贩运人口的补充议定书》（联合国《打击跨国犯罪公约》）；《联合国儿童权利公约》；以及《联合国消除对妇女一切形式歧视公约》。
